paragraphs: Fast Enterprises builds the administrative systems government agencies use to run public-facing programs. The company says it began in 1997 around the idea of all-in-one software for government agencies.

Its tax product, GenTax, is stated to be in use by more than sixty tax and revenue agencies worldwide. A driver and vehicle system covers licensing, identity services, titling, registration and permitting. Another product handles unemployment insurance and paid leave across tax, benefits and appeals. A child support system brings program management into a single place. Audit, collections and identity verification are offered alongside the software as services.

The buyers are national, state or provincial, and local government agencies. The company states its core software is in production at more than a hundred government agencies worldwide. It describes its own aim as being a provider of software and consulting services to government agencies.

quote.text: We work side-by-side with government agencies to implement our solutions
